versions.changelog:
Initial release of apple-health-skill-free (运动健康数据基础版):

- Supports free querying of daily workout plans (no authentication required) and training records sync from health wearables.
- Provides endpoints to get daily training suggestions, fetch historical workout records (up to 90 days), and retrieve athlete profile.
- Requires an API Key for authenticated endpoints (`workouts`, `profile`); daily query limit is 100 for the free version.
- Premium features such as AI coaching, performance charts, statistics, and chat history require upgrading to the full version.
- Includes comprehensive setup instructions, usage examples, error handling, and FAQ section.
